item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Coheed and Cambria - Live at the Starland Ballroom [24bit-48kHz] (DR10)
item.description:
Genre: Progressive rock, post-hardcore
Release date: March 22, 2005

The DVD version of the concert has less limiting than the CD version. It's also in 24-bit 2304kbps LPCM vs the 16-bit 1411kbps PCM that the CD has. Overall it's a more enjoyable listening experience and i'm a bit flabbergasted that we didn't get a 24-bit version available for purchase or streaming. The only way you can legally get this concert in better quality is if you have the DVD that isn't printed anymore
